cases.title: Follow a request
cases.intro: One admitted task stays visible through duplicate delivery and interrupted progress.
cases.criterion: Synthetic Slack intake and truthful progress across duplicates and interruption
frames: The request is recorded once. The repeated callback adds no task.
The selected host and observed native session are attached to this revision.
Progress stopped after disconnect. The latest retained update is shown with its timestamp.

cases.title: Observe, take over, hand back
cases.intro: A visible desktop and an interactive lease have separate authority.
cases.criterion: Passive viewing, denied or interrupted takeover, and fenced handback
frames: The simulated viewer can display a frame. Interactive input stays disabled.
The lease has no authenticated grant. The operator cannot send input.
The reference shows a matched grant and the automation fence. The preview accepts no input.
Release was interrupted. Automation stays fenced until handback is confirmed.

cases.title: Deliver the accepted artifact
cases.intro: Acceptance and delivery have separate receipts for the same artifact.
cases.criterion: Exact accepted artifact, lost delivery acknowledgement, and independent readback
frames: Validation and approval bind the artifact revision and digest.
The upload acknowledgement was lost. Recovery waits for receipt readback.
Readback confirms the same bytes at the authorized destination.

cases.title: Inspect fleet freshness
cases.intro: The source observation time controls the freshness shown for this host.
cases.criterion: Truthful fleet and session freshness when observations expire or disconnect
frames: The latest host observation is inside the freshness window.
The last observation is retained with its original timestamp.
The session stream stopped. The earlier observation remains stale.

cases.title: Read correlated telemetry
cases.intro: Queue, export, persistence, and readback are visible as distinct states.
cases.criterion: Correlated telemetry presents queue, export, persistence, and verified readback separately
frames: Export succeeded. Backend persistence has no confirmed readback.
The backend confirms persistence for this trace.
The returned trace matches the task and session correlation.
